summary_md: **Dante Martin ([@DanteMMartin](https://x.com/DanteMMartin/status/2115179159593038260))** relays a downgraded reading of the Qwen "backdoor" scare: Palisade found an aliyuncs.com endpoint in 3 of 5 Qwen models, but every hit went to Singapore and every one returned 403, which Dante characterizes as leakage rather than sabotage (and notes the finding came from a rival lab). The linked The Decoder article reports that Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers.

referenced_urls.title: Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers, researchers find

relevance: Supply-chain trust signal for anyone running Qwen weights locally: what was actually observed versus the panic.
